scheme_name: Scheme for Providing Financial Assistance for the Purchase of Laptop or Desktop Computer to the Media Persons of the Union Territory of Puducherry
other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for at least ten years.

Applicant must have served for five years in any one of the following positions: full‑time Editor, Reporter, Sub‑Editor, Press Photographer, Correspondent of a newspaper/periodical registered with the Registrar of Newspapers of India; Reporter/Photographer of news agencies in Puducherry with headquarters outside the Union territory; Reporter/Videographer employed by electronic media such as satellite channels.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹15,000 for the purchase of a new laptop or desktop computer.
